from pathlib import Path
import requests,json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
url='https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/releaseDates.json'
attempts=[]
for attempt in range(1,3):
    rec={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
    try:
        r=requests.get(url,timeout=35,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
        rec['http_status']=r.status_code;r.raise_for_status()
        p=out/'sources/H41_官方实际公布日历.json';p.write_bytes(r.content)
        data=r.json();rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest())
        attempts.append(rec)
        print('日历类型：',type(data).__name__,'条目数：',len(data))
        print('头部：',json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False)[:2100])
        print('尾部：',json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False)[-1800:])
        break
    except Exception as e:
        rec.update(status='FAILED',error=str(e)[:700]);attempts.append(rec)
        if getattr(locals().get('r'),'status_code',None) in (403,429):break
(out/'calendar_support_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'url':url,'tls_verify':True,'attempts':attempts},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
